reason: Conversation 1 matches the expected first step: stop using the microwave, unplug it, stop resetting, then see whether the circuit stays on with it unplugged. It also gives a clear escalation: repair or replace the microwave if the circuit holds, and call an electrician if it still trips unplugged. Conversation 2 offers the useful door interlock/monitor-switch hypothesis and an outside door check. But it never tells the user to check whether the RCD stays set with the microwave unplugged. Its step 2 asks the user to note when the trip happens, which contradicts its own instruction to stop using the microwave, and it leans toward the high-voltage system without evidence.
